newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank raises rate on 6-mth repo.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank raises rate on 6-mth repo.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Thursday raised its borrowing rate on the six-month reverse repo to 10.5625 from 10.25 percent.
Dealers said the new rate is in line with the latest six-month treasury bill rate arrived at during the auction last Monday.
"It is raising rates gradually. It doesn't want to rattle the market," a foreign bank dealer said.
Late last week, the Central Bank signalled to the market it wanted rates higher when it lifted its overnight borrowing rate to 10 from 9.9 percent.
Government officials said the Central Bank's move was to siphon liquidity and stop speculation over the peso amid expectations of higher U.S. interest rates.
